text:
Join us this saturday as we return to the colleges of Strixhaven for a draft night! 
 Each player will open a pack pick a card and pass the rest of the pack along. Draft a total of 3 packs of cards and then build a deck on the spot with those cards.
 Finish the event by playing 3 best of 3 matches to decide the winners! First and second place winners will receive packs as prizes!
